title: EvaluationPlan
description: An approved EvaluationPlan binds a nonempty, explicitly enumerated required probe set to stable plan-item identities. The required_probes field is authoritative — it must not be inferred from result rows, default library lists, or presentation output. plan_id + plan_hash establish immutable plan identity. Missing or empty required_probes means readiness cannot be determined.

plan_id.description: Stable machine identifier for this plan.

plan_hash.description: Canonical hash of the plan body (excluding this field). Establishes immutable plan identity.

target_tool_id.description: Exact tool identity this plan applies to.

target_build_id.description: Exact build identity this plan applies to. A mismatch between target_build_id and the build under test must block readiness. A report/exporter cannot confer readiness for a different build.

profile_hash.description: Hash of the DomainProbeProfile this plan was derived from.

required_probes.description: Nonempty, explicitly enumerated list of probe items required by this plan. Must not be empty. Required coverage comes from this field — not from result rows, default library lists, or presentation output.

authorized_by.description: Identity of the authority that approved this plan. Must not be empty or defaulted.

PlanItem.description: Binds a required probe to its immutable definition identity. plan_item_id is stable across plan versions; probe_definition_hash anchors the exact probe version.

plan_item_id.description: Stable plan-item identifier. Survives plan version bumps as long as the requirement is unchanged.

probe_definition_hash.description: Hash of the probe definition this item requires. Authoritative probe identity — not the probe label.
